newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israel's settlement policy could wreck peace - Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Israel's settlement policy could wreck peace - Egypt.

text.p: Egypt said on Saturday the settlement policy of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government could wreck the Middle East peace process.
"The settlement policy, which the Israeli government is adopting, is very serious," Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters.

"It could wreck the peace process on the rock of Israeli rejection and obstinacy," Moussa said before leaving Cairo on his way to New York to head Egypt's delegation at the United Nation's general assembly.
"This policy cannot be described but as rash," he added.
Israel's military administration approved this week plans to build 1,800 new homes to expand a Jewish settlement in the West Bank.
Netanyahu, who ousted Shimon Peres in May elections, won cabinet approval in August to overturn the previous government's building freeze in the West Bank.
